messages:
karen: Quick heads up — docs CI linkcheck failed on the mkdocs build for the new SDK snippets. ~18 broken links, most are relative links inside fenced code blocks getting mangled by the markdown parser.

karen: Error sample from the CI log:
```
LinkCheckError: /docs/sdk/python#creating-a-client -> 404 Not Found
  Referenced from: content/sdk/python/examples.md:42
LinkCheckError: /docs/sdk/javascript) -> 404 Not Found
  Referenced from: content/sdk/js/quickstart.md:12
```

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck failed for PR #2345 — https://ci.internal/redwood/2345 (checks/linkcheck) :warning:

maria: Ugh, this is the classic relative-link + codefence problem. A couple quick options: convert relative links in examples to absolute site paths during build, or escape parens in inline examples. I can throw together a small script to normalize paths under content/sdk/.

maria: Example perl one-liner that will fix common ../sdk/ links (danger: test first):
```
# run from repo root
perl -0777 -pe "s{\]\(\./{1,2}([^ )]+)\)}{](\/docs\/\1)}g" -i content/sdk/**/*.md
```

josh: We need to be careful — docs are versioned. If we rewrite to /docs/sdk/..., that will point to the current site root and might break older version permalinks. Better: generate redirects for older versions in docusaurus config or record mappings in redirects.json.

sophia: Also seeing issues where code fences with inline links like `fetch('/api/v1/users')` get an extra closing paren appended in the rendered HTML when combined with surrounding text. Might be a markdown-it plugin ordering problem in mkdocs/docusaurus. Can someone check which markdown parser/plug-ins we're using in the failing pipeline?

eli: I can take the script and run it in a branch. Plan: 1) run normalization script limited to content/sdk and content/examples, 2) add linkcheck exceptions whitelist (temporary) so other PRs don't pile up, 3) add a CI smoke test that greps for patterns like "]\(\./" inside fenced code blocks.

maria: +1. Also propose adding a pre-commit hook to catch relative links inside ```` ```markdown ```` blocks. Something like a simple grep that exits non-zero. Keeps future PRs clean.

josh: For versioning, I'll add a small script to emit redirect rules mapping the rewritten path back to the versioned path, and wire them into the docusaurus "redirects" plugin config. That should preserve old links while fixing the linkcheck failures on main.

karen: Sounds good. Action items: mari a/eli to open branch `docs/link-normalize-fix`, include the perl/node script, linkcheck whitelist tweak, and the pre-commit grep. josh will add redirect wiring to docusaurus config. sophia please verify markdown parser plugins in the mkdocs/docusaurus pipeline and post findings here.

eli: I'll open the PR and tag @josh and @sophia for review. Estimated: small PR today, follow-up for redirects early next week.

karen: Thanks — please add a short changelog entry for the docs release notes so we can mention the link fixes and redirect behavior. :memo: :shipit:
